title: MessagesRequest
description: Request body for the Messages API. Some parameters apply only to certain models; unsupported parameters are ignored.

model.description: The model to use. Anthropic models also accept their native ids (e.g. `claude-opus-4-8`), which map to `anthropic/claude-opus-4.8`.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate, including thinking and visible output tokens.

messages.description: The conversation so far, in chronological order.

system.description: System prompt. A plain string or an array of text blocks supporting `cache_control`.

top_p.description: Nucleus sampling. If unset, no nucleus truncation is applied. Set only one of `temperature` and `top_p`.

top_k.description: Sample only from the top K tokens. If unset, top-k filtering is disabled.

user_id.description: A unique identifier for the end user. Use hashed or pseudonymous identifiers to avoid passing personally identifiable information.

output_config.description: Controls how the model produces its output.

format.description: Structured output. Constrains the model to return content matching a JSON Schema.

schema.description: The JSON Schema the output must conform to.

cache_control.description: Top-level prompt caching marker. Sets a cache breakpoint on the last cacheable content block in the request, equivalent to setting `cache_control` on that block directly.

CacheControl.description: Prompt caching marker. Sets a cache breakpoint so the stable prefix up to this block can be reused.

FullContentOptions.description: Controls whether to return the full raw content of each result page.

enable.description: If true, returns full_content for each result.

max_tokens.description: Maximum tokens of full content included per result.

HighlightOptions.description: Controls highlight extraction from result pages.

enable.description: If true, returns query-relevant highlight in each result.

MessagesContentBlock.description: A content block within a message. The fields used depend on `type`. For replaying a multi-turn conversation, blocks such as `tool_use`, `tool_result`, `thinking`, `redacted_thinking`, `server_tool_use`, and `web_search_tool_result` are returned verbatim.

media_type.description: Image MIME type. Required when `source.type` is `base64`.

id.description: Block id, replayed verbatim. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

name.description: Tool name, replayed verbatim. For `server_tool_use` it is `octen_search`. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

input.description: Tool call arguments, replayed verbatim. Used by `tool_use` and `server_tool_use` blocks.

tool_use_id.description: The id of the corresponding `tool_use` or `server_tool_use` block. Used by `tool_result` and `web_search_tool_result` blocks.

content.description: Result content. A string or content blocks for `tool_result`; the array of `web_search_result` blocks for `web_search_tool_result`.

is_error.description: Whether the tool execution failed. Used by `tool_result` blocks.

thinking.description: Thinking content, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `thinking`.

signature.description: Thinking signature, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `thinking`.

data.description: Encrypted thinking content, replayed verbatim. Required when `type` is `redacted_thinking`.

MessagesCustomTool.description: A custom tool, executed by the caller and returned via a `tool_result` block.

description.description: A description of what the custom tool does.

input_schema.description: The custom tool's parameter definition in JSON Schema format.

strict.description: Whether to enable strict mode for a custom tool.

MessagesMessage.description: A message in the conversation. Tool results are returned via a `tool_result` content block in a `user` message.

role.description: The role of the message author.

content.description: The content. A plain string or an array of content blocks.

MessagesOctenBroadSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_broad_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

MessagesOctenSearchTool.description: The built-in `octen_search` server tool, executed by Octen.

type.description: `adaptive` lets the model decide the thinking depth.

budget_tokens.description: Thinking token budget. Required when `type` is `enabled`; must be less than `max_tokens`. Not allowed when `type` is `adaptive` or `disabled`.

display.description: Controls how thinking is shown. `summarized` returns thinking blocks; `omitted` returns only the signature so blocks can be replayed. Valid only when `type` is `enabled` or `adaptive`.

MessagesToolChoice.description: Controls whether and how the model calls tools.

type.description: `auto`: model decides; `any`: must call a tool; `tool`: call a specific tool; `none`: no tools.

name.description: The tool name to force. Required when `type` is `tool` (e.g. `octen_broad_search` or `octen_search`).

disable_parallel_tool_use.description: When `true`, the model issues at most one tool call per turn.

MessagesToolDefinition.description: A tool definition. One of a custom tool, the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool, or the `octen_search` tool.

OctenBroadSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_broad_search` tool. Identical to `octen_search` except it accepts `max_queries` instead of `max_searches`. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API.

max_queries.description: Upper bound on the number of sub-queries generated.

OctenSearchToolParameters.description: Behavior configuration for the built-in `octen_search` tool. All parameters are optional and share the same semantics and defaults as the Web Search API. The query is generated automatically by the model; a single request may trigger multiple searches.

max_searches.description: Maximum number of searches allowed in a single request.

include_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically include in the search results. The `site:` query operator adds to this list.

exclude_domains.description: A list of domains to specifically exclude from the search results. The `-site:` query operator adds to this list. If a domain appears in both `include_domains` and `exclude_domains`, `exclude_domains` takes precedence.

include_text.description: Strings that must appear in the result page text.

exclude_text.description: Strings that must not appear in the result page text.

time_basis.description: Determines which time field is used for time filtering. `published` uses time_published; `crawled` uses time_last_crawled. Results missing this field are excluded when filtering by time.

time_range.description: Relative time window counting back from the current time based on `time_basis`. Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are provided, `start_time`/`end_time` take precedence.

start_time.description: Start time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: End time for filtering results. ISO 8601 format.

language.description: A list of languages to restrict results to, as ISO 639-1 codes. By default, no language filter is applied.

format.description: Controls the formatting of highlight outputs.

safesearch.description: Controls filtering of explicit/adult content. `off` disables filtering; `strict` drops all adult content.

include_images.description: Whether to include images in each result.
